2609.29465.title: SWE-Prometheus: Measuring Engineering Governance Improvements in Real-World Repositories
2609.29465.paper_summary: Large language model based coding agents have made substantial progress on repository-level software engineering tasks. Existing repository benchmarks, however, usually start from a human-identified issue and evaluate whether a patch satisfies a functional signal. We present SWE-Prometheus, a benchmark for the broader task of improving repository engineering governance. Each task provides a fixed snapshot and an open-ended objective, requiring the agent to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and verify the resulting changes. SWE-Prometheus evaluates six governance dimensions through paired evidence, clean-environment probes, behavior gates, and two independent teacher ratings of the same evidence. The benchmark contains 60 repositories; ten models are evaluated on a shared 22-repository public subset, where mean Normalized Governance Improvement ranges from 0.0568 to 0.5760 and observed behavior-breakage rates range from 0% to 23%. On a frozen ten-repository batch, a repository-blind template obtains mean NGI 0.272, but its gains concentrate in Tests & CI, Quality Gates, and Documentation; it improves Reproducible Environment and Dependency & Security on none of the repositories. This baseline makes the distinction between adding governance artifacts and producing execution-backed improvements measurable. The no-op condition has median NGI zero and standard deviation 0.073; two teachers agree exactly on 57 of 60 dimension scores for the same no-op evidence. For the two highest conditional-mean systems, common-valid NGI is similar, while full-pool comparisons that include behavior failures favor Kimi-K3. These results show why repository-governance evaluation should report improvement, behavior preservation, evidence quality, and coverage together.
2609.29465.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型基礎的編碼代理在庫級軟體工程任務上取得了顯著進展。然而，現有的庫基準通常從人類識別的問題開始，並評估補丁是否滿足功能信號。我們提出了SWE-Prometheus，一個用於改善庫工程治理的更廣泛任務的基準。每個任務提供一個固定的快照和一個開放式目標，要求代理識別風險、優先干預並驗證所產生的變更。SWE-Prometheus通過配對證據、清潔環境探針、行為閘和兩個獨立教師對相同證據的評分來評估六個治理維度。該基準包含60個庫；十個模型在共享的22個庫公共子集上進行評估，其中平均標準化治理改善範圍從0.0568到0.5760，觀察到的行為破壞率範圍從0%到23%。在一個凍結的十個庫批次中，一個庫盲模板獲得平均NGI 0.272，但其增益集中在測試與CI、質量閘和文檔上；在這些庫上，它未能改善可重複環境和依賴性與安全性。這一基準使得添加治理工件和產生執行支持的改進之間的區別可測量。無操作條件的中位數NGI為零，標準差為0.073；兩位教師對相同無操作證據的60個維度分數中有57個完全一致。對於兩個最高的條件均值系統，通用有效的NGI相似，而包含行為失敗的全池比較則偏向Kimi-K3。這些結果顯示為什麼庫治理評估應該同時報告改進、行為保留、證據質量和覆蓋範圍。
